title: [BUG] USE `crewai create`, select Azure and fill the fields but has an issue
body:
### Description

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "xxx/crew_test/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/openai/_client.py", line 116, in __init__
    raise OpenAIError(
openai.OpenAIError: The api_key client option must be set either by passing api_key to the client or by setting the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable

### Steps to Reproduce

 `crewai create` to create project, select Azure and fill the fields but has an issue

### Expected behavior

fix

### Screenshots/Code snippets

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/39674f32-f6b4-40c0-84f0-06ab6378a6b4)

### Operating System

Ubuntu 22.04

### Python Version

3.10

### crewAI Version

crewai, version 0.121.1

### crewAI Tools Version

crewai, version 0.121.1

### Virtual Environment

Conda

### Evidence

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eccfe6df-eac9-47a7-9118-217b590af02d)

### Possible Solution

fix the fields in `.env`

MODEL=azure/gpt-4o
AZURE_API_KEY=xx
AZURE_API_BASE=xxx
AZURE_API_VERSION=2025-01-01-preview


### Additional context

no

index bcf6030cac..3fff637dee 100644
--- a/src/crewai/cli/utils.py
+++ b/src/crewai/cli/utils.py
@@ -252,7 +252,7 @@ def write_env_file(folder_path, env_vars):
     env_file_path = folder_path / ".env"
     with open(env_file_path, "w") as file:
         for key, value in env_vars.items():
-            file.write(f"{key}={value}\n")
+            file.write(f"{key.upper()}={value}\n")
